reviewer_notes: This paper builds a single Thermoflex thermodynamic process simulation of the Tula refinery cogeneration plant, exercised in three scenarios (Baseline, Optimized Fuel, Transition to RE). The three scenarios share one model/functional form, so they are represented as one model (M1) rather than three. The simulation produces multiple outputs (energy/mass balances, natural gas consumption, electric and CHP efficiency, rate of energy consumption, and emissions); C1 quantity was set to 'energy efficiency ratio' (electric/cogeneration efficiency being the headline energy performance indicator) with requires-inference support because selecting one dependent variable among many outputs is a judgement. The model is validated by comparing simulated versus real observed natural gas consumption per boiler (correlation 0.6408, median difference 7.8%); this was placed in out_of_sample_validation, but validation_design has no matching enum value for 'comparison against independently observed real plant data' (no train/test split or CV), so it is recorded as not reported. Emission results (environmental) were not recorded under energy_result.
